build_schedule_transformed_model: build a ScheduleTransformedModel wrapping a velocity model with original and new schedulers
create_schedule_transformed_model_with_c: create a ScheduleTransformedModel using CondOTScheduler as original and CosineScheduler as new scheduler
run_transformed_model_forward: run the forward pass of a ScheduleTransformedModel with input tensor x and time tensor t
test_schedule_transformed_model: test the ScheduleTransformedModel by sampling with ODESolver using the transformed velocity model
review_schedule_transformed_model_forwar: review the ScheduleTransformedModel forward method that computes transformed marginal velocity using scale-time transformation
